scope: Correct final identity emission for nonzero POINTCLOUD and POINTCLOUDEX definition/reactor references in the public low-level DXF serializers.

issue.before: The serializers wrote source definitionHandle/reactorHandle values directly even when a source-handle remap or caller reference resolver was configured.
issue.impact: Low-level write callers could emit stale references after changing output object identities.

behavior: Both serializers use the configured reference resolver when present; resolver results are treated as final output identities and are not remapped again.
Without a resolver, both serializers use the established source-handle remap fallback.
The concrete dwg2dxf adapter continues to refuse nonzero definition/reactor references until P4 graph closure qualifies them.

validationProfile.source: Locally constructed in-memory POINTCLOUD and POINTCLOUDEX records; no DWG/DXF fixture files.
cases: source-handle remap fallback for both references on both record types
reference-resolver final IDs override the configured remap without double remapping

validation.focusedTestResult: PASS: 1/1; all four ASCII/Binary x resolver/remap cases, 0.43 seconds

limitations: Generated low-level DXF reference translation only; it does not prove target existence, object kind, owner role, graph closure, physical producer coverage, external asset availability, or native consumer behavior.
The adapter graph gate remains fail-closed for nonzero point-cloud definition/reactor references.
No support claim is promoted; P8 remains open.
next: Continue P4 source-bound provider/output binding work for point-cloud definition/reactor graphs, then qualify physical producers and native 3D consumers independently.
